description.value: Karakoram is a traditional Pakistani fine-dining restaurant on Victoria Drive in Vancouver, named after the mountain range where K2 stands. The kitchen specializes in authentic regional Pakistani dishes spanning Western, Punjabi, and Peshawari styles — from sizzling Karahi to slow-cooked Paya — and claims to be a pioneer of real Karahi in Western Canada. A touring cyclist looking for a substantial, flavour-forward South Asian meal will find an extensive menu and weekend brunch service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active Pakistani fine-dining restaurant at 6990 Victoria Drive, Vancouver, with online ordering and dine-in service. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, device charging, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. The menu clearly lists multiple vegetarian items (Veggie Pakora, Veggie Samosa, Daal Chana, Daal Mash, Gol Gappa, Chana Chaat), and an 'Order Online' feature confirms takeout availability. One blog post references 'Karakoram Restaurant in Surrey, BC,' which is inconsistent with the Vancouver address and warrants flagging.
concerns: Postcode discrepancy: OSM has V5P 3Y7 but the website consistently shows V5P 3Y8 across all pages.
One blog post (2025-05-14) references 'Karakoram Restaurant in Surrey, BC' — unclear if this is a second location, a content error, or a planned expansion; the listed address is Vancouver.
No cycling amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website, leaving all required WWC criteria unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a legitimate active business and a plausible cyclist meal stop, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify minimum cycling-friendliness before inclusion.
